title: Origin story: Ilmarinen
description: Ilmarinen was the primordial smith who forged the dome of the sky and hammered the Sampo — the mill of plenty that grinds flour, salt, and gold. Stoic and tireless, he forged even a wife of gold when lonely, and learned that craft cannot replace the living.
